73	    /// VR-34 on `project`, the top-level timeline. `missing`: media pictures whose media has
74	    /// no URL in `document.mediaURLs()` (kept, not followed). `subjects` per clip, read by the
75	    /// following kinds and `speaker` only: the analysis's, or for a picture whose media has a
76	    /// cursor file its cursor's (`FramingCursor`, VR-51), followed by `cursor` with `replace:
77	    /// true`, or shown whole (`fit`) when it is absent. With `speaker` a speaker clip's subjects
78	    /// carry their `turns` (`withTurns`, VR-64 (d)); it is framed `speaker` with its own
79	    /// microphones, every other analysed picture `face`, a refused `speaker` retried as `face`.
80	    static func plan(
81	        _ project: ReelProject, settings: VerticalSettings, subjects: [UInt32: [String: Any]],
82	        missing: Set<UInt32>
83	    ) throws -> Answer {
84	        let old = project.snapshot
85	        let size = settings.shape.size(from: old.canvas)
86	        var trial: SwitchAngle.Trial
87	        let backgrounds: UInt32
88	        switch try opening(project, width: size.width, height: size.height) {
89	        case .refused(let why): return .refused(why)
90	        case .opened(let opened, let track):
91	            trial = opened
92	            backgrounds = track
93	        }
94	        let roles = classify(project)
95	        // Step (6)'s survey is of the OLD snapshot, so step (3) leaves its tracks alone.
96	        let survey = settings.captions ? CaptionRelayout.survey(old) : nil
97	        let relaid = Set(survey?.recognised.map(\.track) ?? [])
98	        var entries: [UInt32: Entry] = [:]
99	        var framed: Set<UInt32> = []
100	        var cursor: [UInt32] = []
101	        let speakers = speakerClips(project, settings: settings, missing: missing)
102	        let speakerOf = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: speakers.map { ($0.clip, $0) })
103	        var speaker: [SpeakerFraming] = []
104	        var moreTracks = 0
105	        var reEased = 0
106	        var carried = 0
107	
108	        // (3b) The camera layouts re-laid first; what they changed is done (VR-53 (d)).
109	        let done: Set<UInt32>
110	        let layouts: [Relaid]
111	        switch try relay(roles, old: old, width: size.width, height: size.height, trial: &trial) {
112	        case .refused(let why): return .refused(why)
113	        case .done(let changed, let made, let switches):
114	            done = changed
115	            layouts = switches
116	            entries.merge(made) { _, new in new }
117	        }
118	
119	        // (3) Each picture, nest and other clip, from the old canvas.
120	        for (id, role) in roles where !done.contains(id) {
121	            guard let clip = old.clip(id), !relaid.contains(clip.track) else { continue }
122	            var follow = FramingFollow.keep
123	            var note: String?
124	            switch role {
125	            case .picture:
126	                if case .media = clip.source {
127	                    if analyses(settings.follow), missing.contains(id) {
128	                        note = "its media file is missing, so it is kept as placed"
129	                    } else if analyses(settings.follow), old.media(for: clip)?.cursor != nil {
130	                        follow = subjects[id] == nil ? .fit : .cursor
131	                        if follow == .fit {
132	                            note = "its cursor file could not be read, so it is shown whole"
133	                        }
134	                    } else if settings.follow == .speaker {
135	                        follow = speakerOf[id] == nil ? .face : .speaker
136	                    } else {
137	                        follow = settings.follow
138	                    }
139	                } else {
140	                    follow = .center
141	                    note = "it is a still picture, so it is centred"
142	                }
143	            case .nest:
144	                follow = .center
145	                note = "it is a nest, so it is centred"
146	            case .other:
147	                break
148	            case .backdrop, .shapePlate, .imagePlate, .graphic, .layoutCamera, .layoutScreen,
149	                .layoutPiece:
150	                continue
151	            }
152	            func op(_ follow: FramingFollow) -> ReelOp {
153	                let own = follow == .speaker ? speakerOf[id] : nil
154	                var read = follow.readsSubjects ? subjects[id] : nil
155	                if follow != .speaker { read?["turns"] = nil }
156	                return .reframeClip(
157	                    clip: id, follow: follow, zoom: settings.zoom,
158	                    whereEmpty: analyses(follow) ? settings.whereEmpty : nil,
159	                    fromWidth: UInt32(old.canvas.width), fromHeight: UInt32(old.canvas.height),
160	                    backdrop: backgrounds, replace: follow == .cursor ? true : nil,
161	                    mics: own?.mics, micFaces: own?.micFaces, subjects: read)
162	            }
163	            let prior = trial.project
164	            var next = prior
165	            var used = follow
166	            var refusedWhy: String?
167	            var speakerWhy: String?
168	            // VR-34's retry, VR-64 (c)'s first: speaker → face → keep, a refused keep stopping.
169	            tried: while true {
170	                switch try prior.applying(op(used)) {
171	                case .applied(let made):
172	                    next = made
173	                    trial.ops.append(op(used))
174	                    break tried
175	                case .identity:
176	                    break tried
177	                case .refused(let refusal):
178	                    guard used != .keep else {
179	                        return .refused(
180	                            "Make Vertical was refused at reframe_clip for clip \(id): "
181	                                + refusal.reason)
182	                    }
183	                    if used == .speaker {
184	                        speakerWhy = refusal.reason
185	                        used = .face
186	                    } else {
187	                        refusedWhy = refusal.reason
188	                        used = .keep
189	                    }
190	                }
191	            }
192	            trial.project = next
193	            moreTracks += next.snapshot.tracks.count - prior.snapshot.tracks.count
194	            if let refusedWhy {
195	                entries[id] = Entry(clip: id, treatment: .notFollowed, reason: refusedWhy)
196	                continue
197	            }
198	            if used == .cursor { cursor.append(id) }
199	            if used == .speaker, let own = speakerOf[id] {
200	                let matched = own.micFaces ?? subjects[id].flatMap {
201	                    project.speakerMatch(clip: id, mics: own.mics, subjects: $0)?.assignment
202	                }
203	                speaker.append(SpeakerFraming(clip: id, mics: own.mics, faces: matched ?? []))
204	            }
205	            if used != .keep {
206	                framed.insert(id)
207	                let counted = FollowSubject.counts(
208	                    before: prior, after: next, clip: id, replace: used == .cursor)
209	                reEased += counted.reEased
210	                carried += counted.carried
211	            }
212	            if let note {
213	                entries[id] = Entry(clip: id, treatment: .notFollowed, reason: note)
214	            } else if role == .other {
215	                entries[id] = Entry(clip: id, treatment: .kept, reason: nil)
216	            } else if let speakerWhy {
217	                // VR-64 (c): followed on its faces, saying why not by who is talking.
218	                let base = followedEntry(clip, prior: prior, next: next)
219	                let reasons = [
220	                    "it follows its faces, not who is talking, because " + speakerWhy, base.reason,
221	                ].compactMap { $0 }
222	                entries[id] = Entry(
223	                    clip: id, treatment: .followed, reason: reasons.joined(separator: " and "))
224	            } else {
225	                entries[id] = followedEntry(clip, prior: prior, next: next)
226	            }
227	        }
228	
229	        // (4) The backdrops and the plates, at the new canvas; a canvas-size graphic re-sized
230	        // to it (VR-42).
231	        let newFill = { (clip: ClipSnapshot) -> Double in
232	            fill(old.sourceSize(of: clip) ?? .zero, width: size.width, height: size.height)
233	        }
234	        for (id, role) in roles where !done.contains(id) {
235	            guard let clip = old.clip(id) else { continue }
236	            let ops: [ReelOp]
237	            let treatment: Treatment
238	            switch role {
239	            case .backdrop(let partner) where framed.contains(partner):
240	                ops = [.delete(clips: [id])]
241	                treatment = .removed
242	            case .backdrop, .imagePlate:
243	                ops = [.setVideo(clips: [id], patch: VideoPatch(x: 0, y: 0, scale: newFill(clip)))]
244	                treatment = .refilled
245	            case .shapePlate:
246	                ops = [
247	                    .setShape(
248	                        clips: [id],
249	                        patch: ShapePatch(width: Double(size.width), height: Double(size.height))),
250	                ]
251	                treatment = .refilled
252	            case .graphic:
253	                ops = graphicOps(clip, from: old.canvas, width: size.width, height: size.height)
254	                treatment = .resized
255	            case .picture, .nest, .other, .layoutCamera, .layoutScreen, .layoutPiece:
256	                continue
257	            }
258	            for op in ops {
259	                if let why = try trial.require(op) {
260	                    return .refused(
261	                        "Make Vertical was refused at \(op.name) for clip \(id): \(why)")
262	                }
263	            }
264	            entries[id] = Entry(clip: id, treatment: treatment, reason: nil)
265	        }
266	
267	        // (5) Backgrounds goes when nothing landed on it.
268	        let kept = !trial.project.snapshot.clips(onTrack: backgrounds).isEmpty
269	        if !kept, let why = try trial.require(.removeTrack(track: backgrounds)) {
270	            return .refused("Make Vertical was refused at remove_track: \(why)")
271	        }
272	
273	        // (6) The word caption tracks re-paged on the new canvas; a track the re-lay keeps
274	        // takes step (3)'s `keep`, so no clip is left without a reframe or an entry.
275	        var captions: CaptionRelayout.Outcome?
276	        if let survey {
277	            var outcome = try CaptionRelayout.relay(survey.recognised, on: &trial)
278	            let unlaid = Set(outcome.kept.map(\.track))
279	            for (id, _) in roles {
280	                guard let clip = old.clip(id), unlaid.contains(clip.track) else { continue }
281	                let op = ReelOp.reframeClip(
282	                    clip: id, follow: .keep, zoom: settings.zoom,
283	                    fromWidth: UInt32(old.canvas.width), fromHeight: UInt32(old.canvas.height),
284	                    backdrop: kept ? backgrounds : nil)
285	                if let why = try trial.require(op) {
286	                    return .refused(
287	                        "Make Vertical was refused at reframe_clip for clip \(id): \(why)")
288	                }
289	                entries[id] = Entry(clip: id, treatment: .kept, reason: nil)
290	            }
291	            outcome.kept = survey.kept + outcome.kept
292	            captions = outcome
293	        }
294	        return .plan(
295	            Plan(
296	                ops: trial.ops, project: trial.project, width: size.width, height: size.height,
297	                entries: entries.keys.sorted().compactMap { entries[$0] }, backgrounds: kept,
298	                moreTracks: moreTracks, reEased: reEased, carried: carried,
299	                captions: captions, cursor: cursor.sorted(), relaid: layouts,
300	                speaker: speaker.sorted { $0.clip < $1.clip }))
301	    }

303	    /// A media picture framed with a following kind or `center`: whole only when the op added
304	    /// a blurred copy AND the framing F is the same at the clip's start, its last tick and
305	    /// every action's two ends; otherwise followed, with why it is not wholly followed.
306	    private static func followedEntry(
307	        _ clip: ClipSnapshot, prior: ReelProject, next: ReelProject
308	    ) -> Entry {
309	        let known = Set(prior.snapshot.clips.map(\.id))
310	        let blurred = next.snapshot.clips.contains {
311	            !known.contains($0.id) && $0.name == blurredName
312	        }
313	        var constant = false
314	        if blurred, let now = next.snapshot.clip(clip.id) {
315	            var times = [now.start, now.start + max(0, now.duration - 1)]
316	            for action in now.actions {
317	                times += [now.start + action.start, now.start + action.endTime]
318	            }
319	            let frames = times.map {
320	                FollowSubject.framing(before: prior, after: next, clip: clip.id, at: $0)
321	            }
322	            if let first = frames.first ?? nil {
323	                constant = frames.allSatisfy { frame in
324	                    guard let frame else { return false }
325	                    return abs(frame.k - first.k) <= 1e-6 && abs(frame.dx - first.dx) <= 1e-6
326	                        && abs(frame.dy - first.dy) <= 1e-6
327	                }
328	            }
329	        }
330	        if constant { return Entry(clip: clip.id, treatment: .whole, reason: nil) }
331	        let reasons = [
332	            blurred ? "it is shown whole on a blurred copy where no subject is found" : nil,
333	            motionNote(clip),
334	        ].compactMap { $0 }
335	        return Entry(
336	            clip: clip.id, treatment: .followed,
337	            reason: reasons.isEmpty ? nil : reasons.joined(separator: " and "))
338	    }

413	    ) -> [SpeakerClip] {
414	        guard settings.follow == .speaker else { return [] }

416	        let micTracks = settings.mics.map { snapshot.clip($0)?.track }
417	        let onMics = Set(micTracks.compactMap { $0 })

439	    /// The media clip with audio on `track` that overlaps `clip` most (ties: the earlier start,
440	    /// then the lower id); nil when none overlaps it.
441	    private static func loudest(
442	        on track: UInt32, under clip: ClipSnapshot, in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot
443	    ) -> UInt32? {
444	        func overlap(_ other: ClipSnapshot) -> Ticks {
445	            max(0, min(other.end, clip.end) - max(other.start, clip.start))
446	        }
447	        let sounding = snapshot.clips(onTrack: track).filter { other in
448	            guard case .media = other.source, snapshot.media(for: other)?.hasAudio == true
449	            else { return false }
450	            return overlap(other) > 0
451	        }
452	        return sounding.min { a, b in
453	            (-overlap(a), a.start, a.id) < (-overlap(b), b.start, b.id)
454	        }?.id

476	    /// longest speaker clip, ties to the lower id) with its own microphones. Main thread.

480	    ) -> SpeakerReading {

562	    /// Whether a base is a layout end within the core's recognition tolerances (1 px, 0.001).
563	    private static func alike(_ video: VideoProps, _ end: VideoPatch) -> Bool {
564	        guard let x = end.x, let y = end.y, let scale = end.scale, let crop = end.crop,
565	            let radius = end.cornerRadius, let opacity = end.opacity
566	        else { return false }

568	        return px(video.x, x) && px(video.y, y) && px(video.crop.l, crop.l)
569	            && px(video.crop.t, crop.t) && px(video.crop.r, crop.r) && px(video.crop.b, crop.b)

614	        let from = (UInt32(old.canvas.width), UInt32(old.canvas.height))
615	        var done: Set<UInt32> = []
616	        for (id, role) in roles where role == .layoutCamera && !done.contains(id) {

618	                clip: id, follow: .layout, fromWidth: from.0, fromHeight: from.1)
619	            let prior = trial.project
620	            guard case .applied(let made) = try prior.applying(op) else { continue }
621	            trial.project = made
622	            trial.ops.append(op)
623	            let after = made.snapshot
624	            for clip in prior.snapshot.clips where after.clip(clip.id) != clip {
625	                done.insert(clip.id)
626	            }
627	        }
628	        var entries: [UInt32: Entry] = [:]
629	        for (id, role) in roles where isLayoutRole(role) || done.contains(id) {
630	            if done.contains(id) {
631	                entries[id] = Entry(clip: id, treatment: .relaid, reason: nil)
632	                continue
633	            }
634	            let keep = ReelOp.reframeClip(
635	                clip: id, follow: .keep, fromWidth: from.0, fromHeight: from.1)
636	            if let why = try trial.require(keep) {
637	                return .refused("Make Vertical was refused at reframe_clip for clip \(id): \(why)")
638	            }
639	            entries[id] = Entry(clip: id, treatment: .notFollowed, reason: handEditedReason)
640	        }
641	        var relaid: [Relaid] = []
642	        let tall = height > width
643	        for (id, role) in roles where role == .layoutCamera && done.contains(id) {
644	            guard let clip = old.clip(id) else { continue }
645	            for action in clip.actions where isLayoutAction(action) {
646	                guard let name = layoutName(action, of: clip, in: old) else { continue }
647	                let to: CameraLayoutKind = tall && name.kind == .sideBySide ? .stacked : name.kind
648	                relaid.append(
649	                    Relaid(camera: id, at: clip.start + action.start, from: name, to: to))
650	            }
651	        }
652	        relaid.sort { ($0.at, $0.camera) < ($1.at, $1.camera) }
653	        return .done(done: done, entries: entries, relaid: relaid)

656	    /// The layout a camera's layout end shows on `snapshot`'s canvas (VR-54), for the summary
657	    /// and the answer only: opacity under 0.5 is Screen Only; x, y, every crop edge and the
658	    /// radius under 0.5 Camera Full; a picture within the corner box (0.25 W + 1 × H/3 + 1) a
659	    /// corner — Circle with a crop, Rounded with a radius, else square, the corner by the signs
660	    /// of x and y; else Stacked below the middle, Side by Side otherwise.
661	    static func layoutName(
662	        _ end: ActionSnapshot, of clip: ClipSnapshot, in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot
663	    ) -> CameraLayoutChoice? {
664	        guard let patch = end.end.video, let x = patch.x, let y = patch.y,
665	            let scale = patch.scale, let crop = patch.crop, let radius = patch.cornerRadius,
666	            let opacity = patch.opacity, let size = snapshot.sourceSize(of: clip)
667	        else { return nil }
668	        let kind = { (kind: CameraLayoutKind) in
669	            CameraLayoutChoice(kind: kind, shape: nil, corner: nil)
670	        }
671	        if opacity < 0.5 { return kind(.screenOnly) }
672	        let edges = [crop.l, crop.t, crop.r, crop.b]
673	        if abs(x) < 0.5, abs(y) < 0.5, edges.allSatisfy({ $0 < 0.5 }), radius < 0.5 {
674	            return kind(.cameraFull)
675	        }
676	        var video = clip.videoProps
677	        video.x = x
678	        video.y = y
679	        video.scale = scale
680	        video.crop = crop
681	        let canvas = snapshot.canvas
682	        let (w, h) = (Double(canvas.width), Double(canvas.height))
683	        let rect = canvasRect(of: clip, in: canvas, sourceSize: size, video: video)
684	        if rect.width <= 0.25 * w + 1, rect.height <= h / 3 + 1 {
685	            let shape: CameraLayoutShape =
686	                edges.contains { $0 > 0.5 } ? .circle : radius > 0.5 ? .rounded : .square
687	            let corner: CameraLayoutCorner =
688	                y > 0
689	                ? (x > 0 ? .bottomRight : .bottomLeft) : (x > 0 ? .topRight : .topLeft)
690	            return CameraLayoutChoice(kind: .corner, shape: shape, corner: corner)
691	        }
692	        return kind(rect.midY > h / 2 + 1 ? .stacked : .sideBySide)
693	    }

695	    /// A re-laid switch's summary line (VR-54).
696	    static func relaidLine(_ relaid: Relaid, canvas: CanvasSnapshot) -> String {
697	        let name =
698	            relaid.from.kind == .corner
699	            ? (relaid.from.shape ?? .square).menuTitle : relaid.from.kind.title
700	        let at = ReelTime.format(relaid.at, fps: canvas.fps, frames: canvas.timecodeFrames)
701	        if relaid.to != relaid.from.kind {

950	///
951	/// - **The path.** Per window (`FramingAnalysis.windows`), CU-25's `path` at `smoothing` 0.5,
952	///   its step `max(60_000, ⌈Σ window lengths ÷ 90_000⌉)` ticks, so a long clip stays under the
953	///   core's sample cap.
954	/// - **The clicks.** `events {clicks}`: each down click (`down == 1`) is a `click: true` point
955	///   at its own `t`, and a path point at that `t` is dropped.
956	/// - **Typing.** `events {typing}`: a point inside a stretch `[from, to]` is `typing: true`.

974	        let step = max(minStep, (total + mostSamples - 1) / mostSamples)
975	        var path: [(t: Ticks, x: Double, y: Double)] = []
976	        var clicks: [(t: Ticks, x: Double, y: Double)] = []

980	            let read = try object(

982	                ["path": ["from": from, "to": to, "step": step, "smoothing": smoothing]])

337	    /// refresh (`offer` presets a set once, so a repeat does nothing until the set is ticked
338	    /// again and its rows rebuilt); a refused one read again at every refresh.
339	    private func reading(_ settings: VerticalSettings) -> VerticalVersion.SpeakerReading {
340	        let key = settings.mics
341	        if let cached = readings[key] {
342	            if case .ready(_, _, let match) = cached.read { picker.offer(match, mics: cached.mics) }
343	            return cached.read
344	        }
345	        guard let document else { return .refused("") }
346	        var unconfirmed = settings
347	        unconfirmed.micFaces = nil
348	        let read = VerticalVersion.speakerReading(
349	            document: document, project: document.project, settings: unconfirmed,
350	            subjects: subjects ?? [:], missing: missing)
351	        guard case .ready(_, let reference, let match) = read else { return read }
352	        // The reference's own microphones named back as the ticked ones, track by track.
353	        let snapshot = document.project.snapshot
354	        let own = VerticalVersion.speakerClips(
355	            document.project, settings: unconfirmed, missing: missing
356	        ).first { $0.clip == reference }?.mics ?? []
357	        let byTrack = Dictionary(
358	            key.compactMap { id in snapshot.clip(id).map { ($0.track, id) } },
359	            uniquingKeysWith: { first, _ in first })
360	        let mics = own.map { snapshot.clip($0).flatMap { byTrack[$0.track] } ?? $0 }
361	        readings[key] = (read, mics)
362	        picker.offer(match, mics: mics)
363	        return read
364	    }

442	/// Make Vertical's step (spec §11 VR-30…VR-35; road map "creator-jobs" VR3a): a project's
443	/// tall or square version as one grouped edit — `set_canvas`, a "Backgrounds" track, one
444	/// `reframe_clip` per picture from the old canvas, its backdrops and plates re-filled — tried
445	/// on one `SwitchAngle.Trial`. The copy is `ProjectDocument+VerticalCopy.swift`'s, the tool
446	/// `AgentServer+VerticalVersion.swift`'s; File ▸ Make Vertical Version… is
447	/// `VerticalVersionSheetController.swift` and `EditorViewController+VerticalVersion.swift` (VR3b,
448	/// VR-39).
449	///
450	/// This file holds the shapes (VR-32), the settings and the classes (VR-33);
451	/// `VerticalVersion+Plan.swift` the step (VR-34); `VerticalVersion+Summary.swift` the summary
452	/// and the answer (VR-35, VR-36); `VerticalVersion+Layers.swift` the graphics (VR-42, VR-44,
453	/// VR4b); `VerticalVersion+Layouts.swift` class 2b and step 3b (VR-53, VR-54, VR5b). Swift restates none
454	/// of VR-26's refusals: a clip the core will not frame reaches `keep` through the core's own
455	/// sentence. Names no `rc_*`.
456	enum VerticalShape: String, CaseIterable {
457	    case tall = "9:16"
458	    case portrait = "4:5"
459	    case square = "1:1"
460	
461	    /// Height over width.
462	    private var ratio: Double {
463	        switch self {
464	        case .tall: return 16.0 / 9.0
465	        case .portrait: return 5.0 / 4.0
466	        case .square: return 1
467	        }
468	    }
469	
470	    /// VR-32: w = min(W, H) rounded down to even; h = 2 × round(w × ratio / 2).
471	    func size(from canvas: CanvasSnapshot) -> (width: Int, height: Int) {
472	        let short = min(canvas.width, canvas.height)
473	        let width = short - short % 2
474	        let height = 2 * Int((Double(width) * ratio / 2).rounded())
475	        return (width, height)
476	    }
477	}

553	    /// VR-33's first match per top-level clip with a picture (not audio-only, not an
554	    /// adjustment clip, video enabled), in id order, on the OLD canvas.
555	    static func classify(_ project: ReelProject) -> [(clip: UInt32, role: Role)] {

558	            uniqueKeysWithValues: snapshot.tracks.enumerated().map { ($0.element.id, $0.offset) })

560	            guard hasPicture(clip, in: snapshot) else { return nil }
561	            return (clip.id, role(of: clip, in: project, order: order))

571	                case .media = clip.source

578	    /// split by whether their media has a URL in `urls` (`document.mediaURLs()`); `missing` are
579	    /// kept, not followed. A present one whose media has a cursor file is in `cursor`, never
580	    /// analysed: it follows its cursor (spec §11 VR-51). The tool's first hop and the sheet
581	    /// both read it (VR-39 (d)).
582	    static func analysisTargets(_ project: ReelProject, urls: [UInt32: URL])
583	        -> (present: [UInt32], missing: Set<UInt32>, cursor: [UInt32])
584	    {
585	        let snapshot = project.snapshot
586	        let pictures = mediaPictures(classify(project), in: snapshot)
587	        let missing = Set(pictures.filter { id in
588	            snapshot.clip(id)?.source.mediaID.map { urls[$0] == nil } ?? false
589	        })
590	        let found = pictures.filter { !missing.contains($0) }
591	        let cursor = found.filter { id in
592	            snapshot.clip(id).flatMap { snapshot.media(for: $0) }?.cursor != nil
593	        }
594	        return (found.filter { !cursor.contains($0) }, missing, cursor)
595	    }

622	    static func fill(_ size: CGSize, width: Int, height: Int) -> Double {
623	        guard size.width > 0, size.height > 0 else { return 1 }
624	        let scale = max(Double(width) / size.width, Double(height) / size.height)

630	    /// A clip that draws pixels: `ProjectSnapshot.layers(at:)`'s test without the time.
631	    private static func hasPicture(_ clip: ClipSnapshot, in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot) -> Bool {
632	        guard clip.enabled.video else { return false }
633	        if case .adjustment = clip.source { return false }
634	        if let media = snapshot.media(for: clip) { return media.hasVideo || media.kind == .image }
635	        return true
636	    }

638	    private static func role(
639	        of clip: ClipSnapshot, in project: ReelProject, order: [UInt32: Int]
640	    ) -> Role {
641	        let snapshot = project.snapshot
642	        let canvas = snapshot.canvas
643	        if clip.name == blurredName, let partner = partner(of: clip, in: snapshot, order: order) {
644	            return .backdrop(partner: partner)
645	        }
646	        let video = clip.videoProps
647	        let centred = abs(video.x) <= 1e-6 && abs(video.y) <= 1e-6
648	        switch clip.source {
649	        case .shape:
650	            if let shape = clip.shape, shape.kind == .rectangle, centred,
651	                abs(video.scale - 1) <= 1e-6,
652	                abs(shape.width - Double(canvas.width)) <= 0.5,
653	                abs(shape.height - Double(canvas.height)) <= 0.5
654	            {
655	                return .shapePlate
656	            }
657	        case .image, .still:
658	            if clip.name == "Background", centred, let size = snapshot.sourceSize(of: clip) {
659	                let fill = fill(size, width: canvas.width, height: canvas.height)
660	                if abs(video.scale - fill) <= 1e-6 * fill { return .imagePlate }
661	            }
662	        case .graphic:
663	            if let graphic = clip.graphic, graphic.width == canvas.width,
664	                graphic.height == canvas.height
665	            {
666	                return .graphic
667	            }
668	        default:
669	            break
670	        }
671	        if let laid = layoutRole(of: clip, in: snapshot, order: order) { return laid }
672	        switch clip.source {
673	        case .media, .still, .image:
674	            if covers(clip, in: project) { return .picture }
675	        case .nest:
676	            if covers(clip, in: project) { return .nest }
677	        default:
678	            break
679	        }
680	        return .other
681	    }

683	    /// (1)'s partner: a clip on a track in front of `clip`'s with an equal source, start and
684	    /// duration; the nearest track first.
685	    private static func partner(
686	        of clip: ClipSnapshot, in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot, order: [UInt32: Int]
687	    ) -> UInt32? {
688	        guard let own = order[clip.track] else { return nil }
689	        return snapshot.clips
690	            .filter {
691	                $0.id != clip.id && (order[$0.track] ?? -1) > own && $0.source == clip.source
692	                    && $0.start == clip.start && $0.duration == clip.duration
693	            }
694	            .min { (order[$0.track] ?? 0, $0.id) < (order[$1.track] ?? 0, $1.id) }?.id
695	    }

697	    /// (3)'s test: the clip's rectangle at its first frame — base props with scale, x and y
698	    /// from `clip_state` at its start — covers one axis of the canvas (both edges at or beyond
699	    /// it, at most 1 px inside) and is centred within 2 % on the other, or covers it too.
700	    private static func covers(_ clip: ClipSnapshot, in project: ReelProject) -> Bool {
701	        let snapshot = project.snapshot
702	        guard let size = snapshot.sourceSize(of: clip) else { return false }
703	        var video = clip.videoProps
704	        if let state = project.clipState(clip.id, at: clip.start)?["video"] as? [String: Any] {
705	            if let scale = (state["scale"] as? NSNumber)?.doubleValue { video.scale = scale }
706	            if let x = (state["x"] as? NSNumber)?.doubleValue { video.x = x }
707	            if let y = (state["y"] as? NSNumber)?.doubleValue { video.y = y }
708	        }
709	        let canvas = snapshot.canvas
710	        let rect = canvasRect(of: clip, in: canvas, sourceSize: size, video: video)
711	        let (w, h) = (Double(canvas.width), Double(canvas.height))
712	        let coversX = rect.minX <= 1 && rect.maxX >= w - 1
713	        let coversY = rect.minY <= 1 && rect.maxY >= h - 1
714	        let centredX = abs(rect.midX - w / 2) <= 0.02 * w
715	        let centredY = abs(rect.midY - h / 2) <= 0.02 * h
716	        return (coversX && (centredY || coversY)) || (coversY && centredX)
717	    }
718	}

746	        let kept = count(.kept)

748	        let refilled = count(.refilled)
749	        if refilled > 0 { text += " Re-fills \(counted(refilled, "background"))." }
750	        let removed = count(.removed)
751	        if removed > 0 {
752	            text += " Removes \(removed) blurred \(removed == 1 ? "copy" : "copies") the "
753	                + "framing replaces."
754	        }

756	        if plan.backgrounds { text += " Adds a Backgrounds track for the blurred copy." }

762	        if plan.carried > 0 {

764	                + (plan.carried == 1 ? "carries" : "carry") + " a framing move."

773	            let why = reason.hasSuffix(".") ? String(reason.dropLast()) : reason

924	    func offer(_ match: SpeakerMatch?, mics assigned: [UInt32]) {

934	                else { continue }

938	        } else {
939	            note.stringValue = Self.unsureNote
940	        }
941	    }

961	        faces = []
962	        offeredFor = nil
963	        note.stringValue = ""

982	    private func fill(_ popup: NSPopUpButton) {

987	        }
988	        popup.selectItem(at: 0)
989	    }

60	        }

73	    /// VR-34 on `project`, the top-level timeline. `missing`: media pictures whose media has
74	    /// no URL in `document.mediaURLs()` (kept, not followed). `subjects` per clip, read by the
75	    /// following kinds and `speaker` only: the analysis's, or for a picture whose media has a
76	    /// cursor file its cursor's (`FramingCursor`, VR-51), followed by `cursor` with `replace:
77	    /// true`, or shown whole (`fit`) when it is absent. With `speaker` a speaker clip's subjects
78	    /// carry their `turns` (`withTurns`, VR-64 (d)); it is framed `speaker` with its own
79	    /// microphones, every other analysed picture `face`, a refused `speaker` retried as `face`.
80	    static func plan(
81	        _ project: ReelProject, settings: VerticalSettings, subjects: [UInt32: [String: Any]],
82	        missing: Set<UInt32>
83	    ) throws -> Answer {
84	        let old = project.snapshot
85	        let size = settings.shape.size(from: old.canvas)
86	        var trial: SwitchAngle.Trial
87	        let backgrounds: UInt32
88	        switch try opening(project, width: size.width, height: size.height) {
89	        case .refused(let why): return .refused(why)
90	        case .opened(let opened, let track):
91	            trial = opened
92	            backgrounds = track
93	        }
94	        let roles = classify(project)
95	        // Step (6)'s survey is of the OLD snapshot, so step (3) leaves its tracks alone.
96	        let survey = settings.captions ? CaptionRelayout.survey(old) : nil
97	        let relaid = Set(survey?.recognised.map(\.track) ?? [])
98	        var entries: [UInt32: Entry] = [:]
99	        var framed: Set<UInt32> = []
100	        var cursor: [UInt32] = []
101	        let speakers = speakerClips(project, settings: settings, missing: missing)
102	        let speakerOf = Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues: speakers.map { ($0.clip, $0) })
103	        var speaker: [SpeakerFraming] = []
104	        var moreTracks = 0
105	        var reEased = 0
106	        var carried = 0
107	
108	        // (3b) The camera layouts re-laid first; what they changed is done (VR-53 (d)).
109	        let done: Set<UInt32>
110	        let layouts: [Relaid]
111	        switch try relay(roles, old: old, width: size.width, height: size.height, trial: &trial) {
112	        case .refused(let why): return .refused(why)
113	        case .done(let changed, let made, let switches):
114	            done = changed
115	            layouts = switches
116	            entries.merge(made) { _, new in new }
117	        }
118	
119	        // (3) Each picture, nest and other clip, from the old canvas.
120	        for (id, role) in roles where !done.contains(id) {
121	            guard let clip = old.clip(id), !relaid.contains(clip.track) else { continue }
122	            var follow = FramingFollow.keep
123	            var note: String?
124	            switch role {
125	            case .picture:
126	                if case .media = clip.source {
127	                    if analyses(settings.follow), missing.contains(id) {
128	                        note = "its media file is missing, so it is kept as placed"
129	                    } else if analyses(settings.follow), old.media(for: clip)?.cursor != nil {
130	                        follow = subjects[id] == nil ? .fit : .cursor
131	                        if follow == .fit {
132	                            note = "its cursor file could not be read, so it is shown whole"
133	                        }
134	                    } else if settings.follow == .speaker {
135	                        follow = speakerOf[id] == nil ? .face : .speaker
136	                    } else {
137	                        follow = settings.follow
138	                    }
139	                } else {
140	                    follow = .center
141	                    note = "it is a still picture, so it is centred"
142	                }
143	            case .nest:
144	                follow = .center
145	                note = "it is a nest, so it is centred"
146	            case .other:
147	                break
148	            case .backdrop, .shapePlate, .imagePlate, .graphic, .layoutCamera, .layoutScreen,
149	                .layoutPiece:
150	                continue
151	            }
152	            func op(_ follow: FramingFollow) -> ReelOp {
153	                let own = follow == .speaker ? speakerOf[id] : nil
154	                var read = follow.readsSubjects ? subjects[id] : nil
155	                if follow != .speaker { read?["turns"] = nil }
156	                return .reframeClip(
157	                    clip: id, follow: follow, zoom: settings.zoom,
158	                    whereEmpty: analyses(follow) ? settings.whereEmpty : nil,
159	                    fromWidth: UInt32(old.canvas.width), fromHeight: UInt32(old.canvas.height),
160	                    backdrop: backgrounds, replace: follow == .cursor ? true : nil,
161	                    mics: own?.mics, micFaces: own?.micFaces, subjects: read)
162	            }
163	            let prior = trial.project
164	            var next = prior
165	            var used = follow
166	            var refusedWhy: String?
167	            var speakerWhy: String?
168	            // VR-34's retry, VR-64 (c)'s first: speaker → face → keep, a refused keep stopping.
169	            tried: while true {
170	                switch try prior.applying(op(used)) {
171	                case .applied(let made):
172	                    next = made
173	                    trial.ops.append(op(used))
174	                    break tried
175	                case .identity:
176	                    break tried
177	                case .refused(let refusal):
178	                    guard used != .keep else {
179	                        return .refused(
180	                            "Make Vertical was refused at reframe_clip for clip \(id): "
181	                                + refusal.reason)
182	                    }
183	                    if used == .speaker {
184	                        speakerWhy = refusal.reason
185	                        used = .face
186	                    } else {
187	                        refusedWhy = refusal.reason
188	                        used = .keep
189	                    }
190	                }
191	            }
192	            trial.project = next
193	            moreTracks += next.snapshot.tracks.count - prior.snapshot.tracks.count
194	            if let refusedWhy {
195	                entries[id] = Entry(clip: id, treatment: .notFollowed, reason: refusedWhy)
196	                continue
197	            }
198	            if used == .cursor { cursor.append(id) }
199	            if used == .speaker, let own = speakerOf[id] {
200	                let matched = own.micFaces ?? subjects[id].flatMap {
201	                    project.speakerMatch(clip: id, mics: own.mics, subjects: $0)?.assignment
202	                }
203	                speaker.append(SpeakerFraming(clip: id, mics: own.mics, faces: matched ?? []))
204	            }
205	            if used != .keep {
206	                framed.insert(id)
207	                let counted = FollowSubject.counts(
208	                    before: prior, after: next, clip: id, replace: used == .cursor)
209	                reEased += counted.reEased
210	                carried += counted.carried
211	            }
212	            if let note {

215	                entries[id] = Entry(clip: id, treatment: .kept, reason: nil)

220	                    "it follows its faces, not who is talking, because " + speakerWhy, base.reason,
221	                ].compactMap { $0 }
222	                entries[id] = Entry(
223	                    clip: id, treatment: .followed, reason: reasons.joined(separator: " and "))
224	            } else {
225	                entries[id] = followedEntry(clip, prior: prior, next: next)
226	            }
227	        }

229	        // (4) The backdrops and the plates, at the new canvas; a canvas-size graphic re-sized
230	        // to it (VR-42).
231	        let newFill = { (clip: ClipSnapshot) -> Double in
232	            fill(old.sourceSize(of: clip) ?? .zero, width: size.width, height: size.height)
233	        }
234	        for (id, role) in roles where !done.contains(id) {
235	            guard let clip = old.clip(id) else { continue }
236	            let ops: [ReelOp]
237	            let treatment: Treatment
238	            switch role {
239	            case .backdrop(let partner) where framed.contains(partner):
240	                ops = [.delete(clips: [id])]
241	                treatment = .removed
242	            case .backdrop, .imagePlate:
243	                ops = [.setVideo(clips: [id], patch: VideoPatch(x: 0, y: 0, scale: newFill(clip)))]
244	                treatment = .refilled
245	            case .shapePlate:
246	                ops = [
247	                    .setShape(
248	                        clips: [id],
249	                        patch: ShapePatch(width: Double(size.width), height: Double(size.height))),
250	                ]
251	                treatment = .refilled
252	            case .graphic:
253	                ops = graphicOps(clip, from: old.canvas, width: size.width, height: size.height)
254	                treatment = .resized
255	            case .picture, .nest, .other, .layoutCamera, .layoutScreen, .layoutPiece:

278	            let unlaid = Set(outcome.kept.map(\.track))
279	            for (id, _) in roles {
280	                guard let clip = old.clip(id), unlaid.contains(clip.track) else { continue }
281	                let op = ReelOp.reframeClip(
282	                    clip: id, follow: .keep, zoom: settings.zoom,
283	                    fromWidth: UInt32(old.canvas.width), fromHeight: UInt32(old.canvas.height),
284	                    backdrop: kept ? backgrounds : nil)

286	                    return .refused(
287	                        "Make Vertical was refused at reframe_clip for clip \(id): \(why)")
288	                }
289	                entries[id] = Entry(clip: id, treatment: .kept, reason: nil)
290	            }
291	            outcome.kept = survey.kept + outcome.kept
292	            captions = outcome
293	        }
294	        return .plan(
295	            Plan(
296	                ops: trial.ops, project: trial.project, width: size.width, height: size.height,
297	                entries: entries.keys.sorted().compactMap { entries[$0] }, backgrounds: kept,
298	                moreTracks: moreTracks, reEased: reEased, carried: carried,
299	                captions: captions, cursor: cursor.sorted(), relaid: layouts,
300	                speaker: speaker.sorted { $0.clip < $1.clip }))
301	    }

303	    /// A media picture framed with a following kind or `center`: whole only when the op added
304	    /// a blurred copy AND the framing F is the same at the clip's start, its last tick and
305	    /// every action's two ends; otherwise followed, with why it is not wholly followed.
306	    private static func followedEntry(
307	        _ clip: ClipSnapshot, prior: ReelProject, next: ReelProject
308	    ) -> Entry {
309	        let known = Set(prior.snapshot.clips.map(\.id))
310	        let blurred = next.snapshot.clips.contains {
311	            !known.contains($0.id) && $0.name == blurredName
312	        }
313	        var constant = false
314	        if blurred, let now = next.snapshot.clip(clip.id) {
315	            var times = [now.start, now.start + max(0, now.duration - 1)]
316	            for action in now.actions {
317	                times += [now.start + action.start, now.start + action.endTime]
318	            }
319	            let frames = times.map {
320	                FollowSubject.framing(before: prior, after: next, clip: clip.id, at: $0)
321	            }
322	            if let first = frames.first ?? nil {
323	                constant = frames.allSatisfy { frame in
324	                    guard let frame else { return false }
325	                    return abs(frame.k - first.k) <= 1e-6 && abs(frame.dx - first.dx) <= 1e-6
326	                        && abs(frame.dy - first.dy) <= 1e-6
327	                }
328	            }
329	        }
330	        if constant { return Entry(clip: clip.id, treatment: .whole, reason: nil) }
331	        let reasons = [
332	            blurred ? "it is shown whole on a blurred copy where no subject is found" : nil,
333	            motionNote(clip),
334	        ].compactMap { $0 }
335	        return Entry(
336	            clip: clip.id, treatment: .followed,
337	            reason: reasons.isEmpty ? nil : reasons.joined(separator: " and "))
338	    }

413	    ) -> [SpeakerClip] {
414	        guard settings.follow == .speaker else { return [] }

416	        let micTracks = settings.mics.map { snapshot.clip($0)?.track }
417	        let onMics = Set(micTracks.compactMap { $0 })

439	    /// The media clip with audio on `track` that overlaps `clip` most (ties: the earlier start,
440	    /// then the lower id); nil when none overlaps it.
441	    private static func loudest(
442	        on track: UInt32, under clip: ClipSnapshot, in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot
443	    ) -> UInt32? {
444	        func overlap(_ other: ClipSnapshot) -> Ticks {
445	            max(0, min(other.end, clip.end) - max(other.start, clip.start))
446	        }
447	        let sounding = snapshot.clips(onTrack: track).filter { other in
448	            guard case .media = other.source, snapshot.media(for: other)?.hasAudio == true
449	            else { return false }
450	            return overlap(other) > 0
451	        }
452	        return sounding.min { a, b in
453	            (-overlap(a), a.start, a.id) < (-overlap(b), b.start, b.id)

476	    /// longest speaker clip, ties to the lower id) with its own microphones. Main thread.
477	    static func speakerReading(
478	        document: ProjectDocument, project: ReelProject, settings: VerticalSettings,
479	        subjects: [UInt32: [String: Any]], missing: Set<UInt32>
480	    ) -> SpeakerReading {

482	        let snapshot = project.snapshot

484	            let (da, db) = (snapshot.clip(a.clip)?.duration ?? 0, snapshot.clip(b.clip)?.duration ?? 0)

497	            project.speakerMatch(clip: reference.clip, mics: reference.mics, subjects: $0)
498	        }
499	        return .ready(subjects: filled, reference: reference.clip, match: match)
500	    }

620	            guard case .applied(let made) = try prior.applying(op) else { continue }

625	                done.insert(clip.id)

627	        }
628	        var entries: [UInt32: Entry] = [:]
629	        for (id, role) in roles where isLayoutRole(role) || done.contains(id) {
630	            if done.contains(id) {

632	                continue
633	            }
634	            let keep = ReelOp.reframeClip(
635	                clip: id, follow: .keep, fromWidth: from.0, fromHeight: from.1)
636	            if let why = try trial.require(keep) {
637	                return .refused("Make Vertical was refused at reframe_clip for clip \(id): \(why)")
638	            }
639	            entries[id] = Entry(clip: id, treatment: .notFollowed, reason: handEditedReason)
640	        }
641	        var relaid: [Relaid] = []
642	        let tall = height > width
643	        for (id, role) in roles where role == .layoutCamera && done.contains(id) {
644	            guard let clip = old.clip(id) else { continue }
645	            for action in clip.actions where isLayoutAction(action) {
646	                guard let name = layoutName(action, of: clip, in: old) else { continue }
647	                let to: CameraLayoutKind = tall && name.kind == .sideBySide ? .stacked : name.kind
648	                relaid.append(
649	                    Relaid(camera: id, at: clip.start + action.start, from: name, to: to))
650	            }
651	        }

653	        return .done(done: done, entries: entries, relaid: relaid)

656	    /// The layout a camera's layout end shows on `snapshot`'s canvas (VR-54), for the summary
657	    /// and the answer only: opacity under 0.5 is Screen Only; x, y, every crop edge and the
658	    /// radius under 0.5 Camera Full; a picture within the corner box (0.25 W + 1 × H/3 + 1) a
659	    /// corner — Circle with a crop, Rounded with a radius, else square, the corner by the signs
660	    /// of x and y; else Stacked below the middle, Side by Side otherwise.
661	    static func layoutName(
662	        _ end: ActionSnapshot, of clip: ClipSnapshot, in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot
663	    ) -> CameraLayoutChoice? {
664	        guard let patch = end.end.video, let x = patch.x, let y = patch.y,
665	            let scale = patch.scale, let crop = patch.crop, let radius = patch.cornerRadius,
666	            let opacity = patch.opacity, let size = snapshot.sourceSize(of: clip)
667	        else { return nil }
668	        let kind = { (kind: CameraLayoutKind) in
669	            CameraLayoutChoice(kind: kind, shape: nil, corner: nil)
670	        }
671	        if opacity < 0.5 { return kind(.screenOnly) }
672	        let edges = [crop.l, crop.t, crop.r, crop.b]
673	        if abs(x) < 0.5, abs(y) < 0.5, edges.allSatisfy({ $0 < 0.5 }), radius < 0.5 {
674	            return kind(.cameraFull)
675	        }
676	        var video = clip.videoProps
677	        video.x = x
678	        video.y = y
679	        video.scale = scale
680	        video.crop = crop
681	        let canvas = snapshot.canvas
682	        let (w, h) = (Double(canvas.width), Double(canvas.height))
683	        let rect = canvasRect(of: clip, in: canvas, sourceSize: size, video: video)
684	        if rect.width <= 0.25 * w + 1, rect.height <= h / 3 + 1 {

```json screen
{
  "title": "Make Vertical Version",
  "project": "demo",
  "steps": [
    {"call": "perform_menu_item", "args": {"path": ["File", "Make Vertical Version…"]}}

  "captures": [{"name": "sheet", "window": "sheet"}],
  "after": [{"call": "cancel_sheet", "args": {}}],
  "expect": [{"capture": "sheet", "visible_text": "Make Vertical Version"}]
}
```

The Make Vertical Version sheet (road map "creator-jobs" VR3b, spec §11 VR-39) comes up from
File ▸ Make Vertical Version… on any project with a clip, with no nest open — here the `demo`
fixture. Make makes the timeline's tall or square version: a new canvas, each full-frame movie
clip following its subject, stills and nests centred, everything else kept as placed, and a
blurred copy behind a clip where it shows the whole picture. With Make a copy ticked it opens as
a new untitled project, "<name> (9:16)", and the project behind the sheet does not change;
unticked, it is one undo step "Make Vertical" on this project.

Under the bold title "Make Vertical Version", a muted hint: "Makes a version of the timeline for
a tall or square canvas. Each full-frame movie clip follows its subject with eased moves (with
Speaker, whoever is talking on the ticked microphones), stills and nests are centred, and everything else is kept as placed, with a blurred copy behind a clip
where it shows the whole picture. With Make a copy it opens as a new project and this one does
not change. One undo step." Then a grid, each row with its right-aligned label:

- "Shape:" — a pop-up of the shapes whose size differs from the canvas, each with its size;
  from the fixture's 960 × 540 canvas, "9:16 (540 × 960)" (shown), "4:5 (540 × 676)" and
  "1:1 (540 × 540)"; from 1920 × 1080, 1080 × 1920, 1080 × 1350 and 1080 × 1080. A 1080 × 1920
  canvas would offer only 4:5 and 1:1.
- "Follow:" — a pop-up of Subject, Faces, People, Salient Region, Speaker and Center; Subject
  here (pinned by `FrameJobFollowKind`, the key Follow Subject's sheet shares; a stored Speaker
  opens this sheet on Speaker and Follow Subject's on Subject).
- "Zoom:" — a whole-number field and "%", always opening at 100, the fill.
- "Where Empty:" — a pop-up of Show Whole and Center; Show Whole here (pinned by
  `FrameJobFollowWhereEmpty`). It is dimmed while Follow is Center.
- a "Make a copy" checkbox, ticked whenever the sheet opens.

With Follow on Speaker (not shown: the catalog pins Subject; `vr6b_proof.py`'s Q6 reads its
layout dump), a second grid follows under the first, its labels in the same column:
"Microphones:" — one checkbox per track holding a sound file, named by the track ("Mic A",
"Mic B"), the first four ticked; "Faces:" — one row per ticked microphone, the track's name and
a pop-up of "Choose a face" and each face found, "Face 1 (42 % across)"; then a muted note, "Each
microphone is matched to the face that talks with it; change one if it is wrong." when the
pop-ups are preset from a sure match, else "The faces do not show clearly who is on each
microphone: choose each microphone's face." with every pop-up on "Choose a face". Make stays off
until two to four microphones are ticked and each has a face of its own.

Under the grid, one muted summary says what Make would do. The fixture's movie does not fill

---
title: Make Vertical Version
description: Turn a landscape edit into a tall or square version for a phone, a reel or a square post, in one step over the whole timeline.
---

import { Steps } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';
import AtAGlance from '@components/AtAGlance.astro';
import Shot from '@components/Shot.astro';

Make Vertical Version makes a tall or square version of a landscape edit, for a phone, a reel or a square post. It changes the canvas and reworks the whole timeline in one step, so you don't have to frame each clip yourself.

<AtAGlance
  menu="File ▸ Make Vertical Version…"
  tools="make_vertical_version"
  needs="Nothing. Faces, people and shot changes are found on your Mac, with no key and no upload."
/>

## Make a vertical version

<Steps>

1. Choose **File ▸ Make Vertical Version…**. It has no keyboard shortcut. It's available when the project has a clip, no [nest](/editing/nests/) is open, no other sheet is up and nothing is recording.

2. Pick a [**Shape**](#shape).

3. Choose what to [**Follow**](#follow), and set [**Zoom**](#zoom) and [**Where Empty**](#where-empty) if you want to.

4. Leave [**Make a copy**](#make-a-copy) ticked to keep this project as it is, or untick it to change this project.

5. [Read the summary](#read-the-summary) under the controls. It says what will happen before anything does.

6. Choose **Make** (<kbd>Return</kbd>), or **Cancel** (<kbd>Esc</kbd>) to leave everything as it was.

</Steps>

<Shot
  name="15j-make-vertical-sheet.sheet"
  alt="The Make Vertical Version sheet, with Shape on 9:16 (540 × 960), Follow on Subject, Zoom at 100 %, Where Empty on Show Whole and Make a copy ticked. The summary under them reads: Makes a 540 × 960 version. Keeps 4 clips as placed."
/>

Each clip is treated by what it is: full-frame movies follow their subject, screen recordings follow the pointer, camera layouts are laid out again, and so on. [What Make Vertical changes](/framing/vertical-what-changes/) goes through it clip by clip.

## The controls

### Shape

Each row shows the size it makes, such as **9:16 (1080 × 1920)**. The new canvas keeps the old short side, rounded down to an even number, and the height follows from the shape.

| Shape | From 1920 × 1080 |
| --- | --- |
| **9:16** | 1080 × 1920 |
| **4:5** | 1080 × 1350 |
| **1:1** | 1080 × 1080 |

A shape the canvas already has isn't in the list.

### Follow

What each movie clip keeps in the frame.

| Choice | What the frame follows |
| --- | --- |
| **Subject** | A face. Where there's no face, a person. Where there's neither, the region the eye goes to. |
| **Faces** | Faces only. |
| **People** | People only. |
| **Salient Region** | Only the region the eye goes to. |
| **Speaker** | Whoever is talking, for a wide shot with a microphone per person. See [Follow the speaker in a vertical](/framing/follow-speaker/). |
| **Center** | The middle of the picture, for the whole clip. Needs no analysis, so the summary is ready at once. |

These are the choices of [Follow Subject](/framing/follow-subject/), plus **Speaker**. The two commands share one remembered choice, saved when you choose **Make**. It starts on **Subject**. If you last chose **Speaker**, Follow Subject, which doesn't offer it, opens on **Subject**.

### Zoom

How tight the frame is, from 100 to 400 %, in whole numbers. 100 % is the smallest scale at which a picture covers the new canvas. Higher values frame closer.

**Zoom** starts at 100 % every time and isn't remembered. The summary catches up when you leave the field.

### Where Empty

What a followed clip shows while there's nothing to follow.

| Choice | What the frame shows |
| --- | --- |
| **Show Whole** | The whole picture on a blurred copy of itself. This is the default. |
| **Center** | The middle of the picture. |

It's off while **Follow** is **Center**. It's the same remembered choice as Follow Subject's.

### Make a copy

Ticked, the vertical version opens as a new untitled project and this project doesn't change. The copy is named after this project with the shape, such as "Interview (9:16)", "Interview (4:5)" or "Interview (1:1)". It carries the project's caches and analysis. Save it when you want to keep it.

Unticked, this project itself becomes the vertical version.

The box is ticked whenever the sheet opens, and your choice isn't remembered.

## Read the summary

Under the controls, the sheet says what **Make** will do, and it changes as you change a control. It opens with the new size, "Makes a 1080 × 1920 version.", and goes on with whichever of these apply:

| The summary says | What it means |
| --- | --- |
| "Follows 3 clips." | Movie clips that follow what you chose. |
| "Follows the cursor in 2 clips, their own zooms and pans replaced." | Screen recordings that follow the pointer. |
| "Follows whoever is talking in 1 clip." | Wide shots framed on the speaker. |
| "Re-lays 2 camera layouts for the new canvas." | Camera layout switches made again. |
| "Shows 1 clip whole on a blurred copy." | Clips with nothing to follow at any point. |
| "Keeps 4 clips as placed." | Clips moved and scaled to the new canvas, not framed. |
| "Re-fills 1 background." | Blurred copies and background plates resized to cover the new canvas. |
| "Removes 1 blurred copy the framing replaces." | Old blurred copies that are no longer needed. |
| "Re-sizes 1 graphic to the new canvas." | Graphics exactly the old canvas's size. |
| "Updates 1 graphic module to the current template." | Older copies of a bundled template, in a copy only. |
| "Adds a Backgrounds track for the blurred copy." | A new track at the back for the blurred copies. |
| "Adds 1 more track behind it where clips overlap." | A further track, for copies that overlap in time. |
| "2 actions re-eased at a cut." | Actions on a clip eased again where the framing cuts. |
| "2 actions carry a framing move." | Actions that now carry a move of the framing as well. |
| "Re-lays 1 caption track for the new canvas." | Word captions paged again for the narrow frame. |

After those come single lines for what needs your attention:

- One line per camera layout switch: "Re-laid: Side by Side → Stacked at 00:00:10:00."
- One line per clip that isn't followed, or is only partly followed, with the reason: "Clip 6 is not followed: its media file is missing, so it is kept as placed." or "Clip 2 is followed, but it is shown whole on a blurred copy where no subject is found."
- One line per caption track that's kept as it was, and one per graphic module left as it is.

If the movies have already been analysed, the summary reads "Reading the analysis…" for a moment, and **Make** is dimmed until it's done.

If Frame Job can't make the new version, the summary says why and **Make** stays dimmed. That happens when a project is at its limit of 64 tracks, nests included, because Make Vertical needs a track for the blurred copies.

## When the movies need analysing

Following a subject needs to know where the faces, people and shot changes are. When the movies haven't been analysed yet, the summary says so: "Finds the faces, people and shot changes in 3 files on this Mac first, then makes a 1080 × 1920 version."

**Make** then shows the Analyzing sheet while that runs on your Mac, and makes the version when it's done. **Stop** makes nothing: no project opens and this one doesn't change.

**Center** needs no analysis, and a recording that follows its pointer is never analysed. With **Speaker**, the sheet comes back after the analysis so you can [confirm who is on each microphone](/framing/follow-speaker/#the-sheet-comes-back-after-analysis).

If an analysis fails, Frame Job beeps, makes nothing and names the file at the foot of the inspector.

## Make another shape

What was found stays in this project's cache and is carried into the copy, so making another shape afterwards needs no analysis. Choose the command again on the landscape project and pick the next shape.

## Undo Make Vertical

The whole change is one undo step. In the copy, **Edit ▸ Undo Make Vertical** gives back the landscape edit. In place, it takes the command back on this project.

## Keep the picture sharp

A vertical canvas shows the middle of a landscape picture enlarged. A 1080p source framed on 1080 × 1920 is enlarged ×1.78, which can look soft on a phone, and a **Zoom** above 100 % enlarges it further. Shoot 4K for footage you mean to make vertical.

## Good to know

- Make Vertical works on the top-level timeline. A [nest](/editing/nests/) is treated as one clip, and what's inside it isn't reframed.
- If the project changes while the sheet is open or the analysis runs, nothing is made. Frame Job beeps and the foot of the inspector says "the project changed while the Make Vertical Version sheet was open, so nothing was made. Choose Make Vertical Version again." or "the project changed while Make Vertical was analyzing, so nothing was made. Choose Make Vertical Version again."
- If the step wouldn't change the copy, the copy is closed and nothing is made: "Make Vertical did not apply to the copy, so nothing was made."

## With an agent

`make_vertical_version` makes the same version from a named shape. It differs from the sheet in a few ways:

- It can save the copy straight to a place you choose, and the assistant asks first when it does.
- It can leave caption tracks as placed, where the sheet always pages them again.
- It waits up to 60 s for an analysis. Past that nothing is made, and calling it again carries on.

See [Tools: framing and vertical](/mcp/tools-framing/).

## Related

- [What Make Vertical changes](/framing/vertical-what-changes/)
- [Follow the speaker in a vertical](/framing/follow-speaker/)
- [Follow Subject](/framing/follow-subject/)
- [Graphics in a vertical version](/graphics/vertical-graphics/)
- [Re-lay captions for a canvas](/captions/re-lay-captions/)
- [Canvas size](/projects/canvas-size/)

---
title: What Make Vertical changes
description: Clip by clip, what Make Vertical Version does to movies, screen recordings, camera layouts, stills, graphics, captions and everything else.
---

import AtAGlance from '@components/AtAGlance.astro';

[Make Vertical Version](/framing/make-vertical-version/) doesn't crop the timeline as one picture. It looks at each clip and treats it by what it is, so a talking head follows its subject while a title stays a title. This page says what happens to each kind of clip, and what the sheet's summary says about it.

<AtAGlance menu="File ▸ Make Vertical Version…" tools={['make_vertical_version', 'reframe_clip']} />

## How a clip is judged

Every clip with a picture on the top-level timeline is judged on the old canvas. The first row that fits decides what happens to it.

| The clip | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| A [blurred copy](#blurred-copies-and-background-plates) behind a clip | Removed, or re-filled to cover the new canvas |
| A [background plate](#blurred-copies-and-background-plates) | Re-filled to cover the new canvas |
| A [graphic exactly the old canvas's size](#graphics) | Re-sized to the new canvas |
| A [camera or a screen in a camera layout](#camera-layouts) | Laid out again for the new canvas |
| A [screen recording with its cursor file](#screen-recordings) that fills the frame | Follows the pointer |
| A [movie](#full-frame-movies) that fills the frame | Follows its subject |
| A [still, picture or nest](#stills-pictures-and-nests) that fills the frame | Centred |
| [Word captions](#word-captions) | Paged again for the narrow frame |
| [Everything else](#everything-else) | Kept as placed |

A clip **fills the old frame** when its rectangle at its first frame covers the canvas on one side, to within a pixel at each edge, and on the other side is centred to within 2 % or covers that too. A sound-only clip, a clip with its video turned off and an adjustment clip have no picture here, so nothing happens to them.

## Full-frame movies

A movie clip that fills the old frame follows what you chose in **Follow**, as [Follow Subject](/framing/follow-subject/) frames it. Its own moves and actions stay, inside the framing.

The summary tells you how each one went:

| The clip | The summary says |
| --- | --- |
| Follows its subject | It's counted in "Follows 3 clips." |
| Has nothing to follow at any point | It's counted in "Shows 1 clip whole on a blurred copy." |
| Has nothing to follow for part of its length | It's still counted as followed, with "Clip 2 is followed, but it is shown whole on a blurred copy where no subject is found." |
| Moves by a motion of its own | "Clip 2 is followed, but moves by its own motion: …", with the motion's name, because that move isn't part of the framing. |

- A movie whose file is missing: "Clip 6 is not followed: its media file is missing, so it is kept as placed." With **Follow** on **Center** it's centred like any other clip instead.
- A clip on a [matte track](/canvas/matte-tracks/), or one a matte cuts, because framing would move it out of the matte.
- A clip turned by its rotation or by an action, or one that spins in its motion, because framing works on an upright picture.

## Screen recordings

A screen recording with its [cursor file](/recording/cursor-files/) follows the pointer instead of a face, because a face on a screen isn't what the viewer is looking at.

- It holds still while you type.

| On the old canvas | On the new canvas |
| --- | --- |
| A Corner | A Corner in the same corner |
| Camera Full | Camera Full |
| Side by Side, going to a tall canvas | Stacked, with the screen across the top and the camera below it, so the screen isn't squeezed into two-thirds of a narrow frame |
| Side by Side, going to a square | Side by Side |

The camera, the screen and the cut pieces of either are never followed and get no blurred copy. A zoom on the screen keeps showing the same part of the picture.

The summary counts them, "Re-lays 2 camera layouts for the new canvas.", and lists each switch: "Re-laid: Side by Side → Stacked at 00:00:10:00."

A circle or panel crop is re-centred on the middle of the crop it had. A crop that had room to move may sit nearer the middle of the camera picture than a switch made directly on the new canvas would.

### A layout changed by hand

If a camera was moved or resized by more than a pixel after its switch, it's no longer a layout Frame Job made. The camera and its screen are kept as placed, and the summary says "Clip 6 is not followed: its camera layout was edited by hand, so it is kept as placed."

## Stills, pictures and nests

A still or a picture that fills the frame is centred, and so is a [nest](/editing/nests/) that does. There's nothing inside them to follow. The summary lists each one: "Clip 4 is not followed: it is a still picture, so it is centred." or "Clip 4 is not followed: it is a nest, so it is centred."

What's inside a nest isn't reframed. A still, picture or nest that doesn't fill the frame is [kept as placed](#everything-else).

## Graphics

A graphic exactly the old canvas's size, such as a full-frame lower third or title card, is re-sized to the new canvas, so it lays itself out again on the narrow frame. Its position and the positions its actions move it to shrink and stretch with the two sides, and its scale stays as it was. Any other graphic is [kept as placed](#everything-else).

Older copies of the bundled templates in the project are updated in a copy, and listed when you apply the step in place: "Graphic module "intro" is left as it is: it is an older copy of the bundled template "lower-third"; Make Vertical updates it only in a copy." A module of your own that sizes itself by the canvas's height is listed too, and never rewritten. See [Graphics in a vertical version](/graphics/vertical-graphics/).

## Everything else

Titles, other graphics, shapes, a picture-in-picture and any clip that doesn't fill the frame are kept as placed. They're moved and scaled from the old canvas to the new one, as the Document tab does when a [canvas change](/projects/canvas-size/) rescales clips:

- A clip's horizontal position follows the change in width.
- Its vertical position follows the change in height.
- Its scale follows the smaller of the two changes, so something that fitted the old canvas still fits the new one.

From 1920 × 1080 to 1080 × 1920, a title's distance from the centre shrinks to 0.56 across and grows to 1.78 down, and the title itself shrinks to 0.56 of its size. The positions and scales its actions move to change the same way.

## Blurred copies and background plates

A blurred copy already behind a clip is removed when that clip is framed, because the framing makes a new one where it's needed. Otherwise it's re-filled to cover the new canvas. A copy counts as one when it's named **Blurred Background** and a clip of the same source, start and length sits in front of it.

A background plate from **Clip ▸ Add Background** is re-filled too. A plate is a rectangle shape the canvas's size, centred at scale 1, or an image or still named **Background** that fills the canvas. See [Backgrounds](/canvas/backgrounds/).

## Word captions

Word captions are paged again for the narrow frame from the words their pages hold, every correction kept, as **File ▸ Re-lay Captions for This Canvas** does. See [Re-lay captions for a canvas](/captions/re-lay-captions/). A track that was hidden or locked stays that way.

- it's a matte track
- a page has no word timings, or none of a page's words starts inside it
- a page is in a style Frame Job doesn't make, or its pages are in more than one style
- its pages wouldn't fit

- [Camera layouts](/framing/camera-layouts/)
- [Reframe a clip (agents)](/framing/reframe-clip/)
- [Tools: framing and vertical](/mcp/tools-framing/)

---
title: Follow the speaker in a vertical
description: Make a vertical version of a wide interview that cuts to whoever is talking, using a microphone per person.
---

import { Steps } from '@astrojs/starlight/components';
import AtAGlance from '@components/AtAGlance.astro';

A wide shot of two to four people doesn't fit a tall frame. Follow Speaker solves that: in [Make Vertical Version](/framing/make-vertical-version/), it reads each person's microphone and cuts the frame to whoever is talking.

<AtAGlance
  menu="File ▸ Make Vertical Version…"
  where="Follow ▸ Speaker in the sheet"
  tools={['make_vertical_version', 'reframe_clip']}
  needs="A microphone for each person, on its own track. Faces are found on your Mac, with no key and no upload."
/>

## What you need

- A wide shot: a full-frame movie clip with the people in it.
- A sound file for each person, from a recorder or a lavalier rather than a camera, each on its own track and recorded with the shot.
- Those sound files lined up with the shot. Use [**Clip ▸ Synchronize Audio**](/audio/synchronize-audio/) first.

## Follow the speaker

<Steps>

1. Choose **File ▸ Make Vertical Version…** and set **Follow** to **Speaker**. The **Microphones** and **Faces** rows appear.

2. Under [**Microphones**](#microphones), tick the tracks that belong to the people in the shot, two to four.

3. Under [**Faces**](#faces), check that each row names that microphone's person. If the movies haven't been analysed yet the rows are empty for now.

4. Choose **Make**. If an analysis has to run first, [the sheet comes back](#the-sheet-comes-back-after-analysis) when it's done, so you can do step 3 and choose **Make** there.

</Steps>

The other controls work as they do in [Make Vertical Version](/framing/make-vertical-version/#the-controls).

## Microphones

A checkbox for each track holding a sound file, named by the track and listed front to back. A camera's track isn't offered, and neither is one whose sound is off. The first four are ticked.

Tick the ones that belong to the people in the shot.

When no full-frame movie plays beside two ticked microphones, the sheet says "No full-frame movie clip plays beside two of the ticked microphones, so nobody can be framed by who is talking." and **Make** stays off.

## Faces

One row per ticked microphone, with a pop-up of the faces Frame Job found in the longest shot it can frame this way. Faces are numbered left to right, with where each sits across the picture: **Face 1 (42 % across)**.

Ticking or unticking a microphone rebuilds the rows and offers the match again for the new set. Otherwise your own choice stands.

### The automatic match

Frame Job matches each microphone to the face whose mouth moves while it talks. When the match is clear the pop-ups are already set, and the note under them reads "Each microphone is matched to the face that talks with it; change one if it is wrong." Check that each row names that microphone's person.

A match is clear when every microphone agrees with its face to at least 0.2, on a scale where 1 is perfect agreement and 0 is none. A face is counted when it's in at least a quarter of the shot, and four faces at most are considered.

### Choose a face

When the faces don't show who is whose, because mouths are too still or too small to read, each pop-up says **Choose a face** and the note reads "The faces do not show clearly who is on each microphone: choose each microphone's face." Pick each microphone's face yourself.

If the shot shows fewer faces than you've ticked microphones, the pop-ups have no faces to offer. Untick the microphones of people who aren't in it.

## When Make is offered

**Make** is on when all of these are true:

- Two to four microphones are ticked.
- A shot plays beside two of them.
- Every ticked microphone has a face of its own. Two microphones can't share a face.

While an analysis is still to be made there are no faces to choose yet, so the last rule waits: **Make** is on with the first two, and pressing it runs the analysis.

When a microphone has only just been imported, it may still be being measured. The sheet says so in the words [Switch by Speaker](/multicam/switch-by-speaker/) uses, such as "The microphone on track 3 is still being analysed — its loudness has not been measured yet. Try again in a moment." Choose the command again in a moment. A microphone with no speech under the shot stops **Make** in the same way, with "The microphone on track 3 has no speech between …". Untick it.

## The sheet comes back after analysis

The summary warns you first: "Finds the faces, people and shot changes in 3 files on this Mac first, then asks you to confirm who is on each microphone, then makes a 1080 × 1920 version."

When you choose **Make**, the Analyzing sheet runs. Then the sheet comes back on the same shape, **Follow**, **Zoom**, **Where Empty**, **Make a copy** and ticked microphones, this time with faces to confirm. Nothing is made until you choose **Make** there. **Stop** on the Analyzing sheet makes nothing.

## How the shot is cut

A shot is framed this way when it's a full-frame movie, its file is present, it has no cursor file, it isn't on a microphone track, and it overlaps sound on at least two ticked microphones. Frame Job doesn't count the people in it. The summary counts these shots: "Follows whoever is talking in 1 clip."

Who talks when is read the way Switch by Speaker reads the microphones, with its default settings, so the two agree.

- Each change of speaker is a cut, not a move.
- Each framing holds at least 2 s, so a short reply doesn't cut away and back.
- Two people talking at once are framed together when they fit. When they don't, the frame stays on the person already in it.
- While nobody talks, the last speaker stays.

Every other movie clip follows its faces, and screen recordings and everything else are treated as usual. See [What Make Vertical changes](/framing/vertical-what-changes/).

## Shots that follow their faces instead

A shot that can't be framed by who is talking follows its faces instead, and the summary says why: "Clip 3 is followed, but it follows its faces, not who is talking, because …". The usual reasons are:

- It changes shot. Follow Speaker frames one wide shot, so split the clip first with **Clip ▸ Split at Shot Changes**.
- It shows fewer faces than the microphones under it.
- Nobody talks inside it on those microphones.

## Good to know

- The faces you confirm come from the longest shot and apply to every shot by number, counting left to right. If people sit in a different order in another shot, that shot frames the wrong person.
- A shot uses only the ticked microphones that sound under it, so a microphone used elsewhere in the timeline doesn't count against it.
- [Follow Subject](/framing/follow-subject/) doesn't offer **Speaker**. Only Make Vertical Version and an agent do.

## With an agent

An agent makes the same version with `make_vertical_version`, naming two to four microphone clips, each standing for its track, and the faces if it wants to set them. Nobody confirms a match, so a shot whose faces don't show who is whose follows its faces, with the reason in the answer, unless the call names them. `reframe_clip` frames one clip on whoever is talking, on the canvas it's already on. See [Reframe a clip (agents)](/framing/reframe-clip/) and [Tools: framing and vertical](/mcp/tools-framing/).

## Related

- [Make Vertical Version](/framing/make-vertical-version/)
- [What Make Vertical changes](/framing/vertical-what-changes/)
- [Synchronize Audio](/audio/synchronize-audio/)
- [Switch by Speaker](/multicam/switch-by-speaker/)
